candidates.snippet: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards says a new “prohibited zone” outside the Strait of Hormuz will extend into parts of the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea, placing further restrictions on commercial shipping in the region https://t.co/6w6XbDEsR2

Syrian security forces were deployed at the site of an arms depot explosion that killed 14 people, according to the local health department, which did not specify the cause of the blast.
 
The explosion occurred near the city of Sarmada, in Syria’s northwestern Idlib province. ht
